name: Reducing Warp Pressure
summary: Method Effect Short rest Reduce Warp Pressure to 0. Long rest Reduce Warp Pressure to 0. Vent as an action Make a DC 12 Wisdom save. On success, reduce Warp Pressure by 1d4 + proficiency bonus. On failure, reduce it by 1 and take 1d6 psychic damage. Kill with Focused Rupture Reduce Warp Pressure by 1. Stabilising Focus Reduce Warp Pressure by 1 once per short rest.
